response.original_title: Rock Milestones: The Rolling Stones - The Singles 1962-1970
response.overview: Are the Stones the greatest singles band ever?..discuss.  During one unforgettable decade, The Rolling Stones produced a flood of songs that would go on to become indisputable rock-and-roll classics.  This is the long awaited critical review of the music, featuring rare live performances alongside analysis from a leading team of rock journalists and critics.
response.tagline: WOULD YOU LET YOUR DAUGHTER MARRY A ROLLING STONE?
